qt: to the Commission Peter Agius (PPE) Subject:

In the light of concerns about pressure, retaliation and intimidation directed at academics and students for their lawful political expression, including the dismissal of tenured Maltese professor Michelle Pace at Roskilde University (RUC), Denmark, on 16 December 2025, what action is the Commission taking to safeguard academic freedom and freedom of expression in European universities? The Council Recommendation of 25 November 2024 on attractive and sustainable careers in higher education calls on Member States to ensure that academic staff can teach and conduct research without interference or fear of reprisal, including through effective monitoring mechanisms and frameworks protecting individuals against undue interference and threats. Given Denmark’s national legal provisions on research freedom, has the Commission assessed whether Denmark and other Member States have effective mechanisms to implement these European principles in practice, including protection against disciplinary action or dismissal linked to lawful academic or political expression? What monitoring mechanisms does the Commission use to assess implementation, and will it consider further measures to ensure that academics and students across the EU can exercise their fundamental freedoms without fear of retaliation?
